'''September 2000 Seattle tournament (23 September)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Broken Games, Seattle, WA on 23 September 2000. [[Douglas Harvilla]] won it. It is known from Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1264">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-broken-games-seattle-wa-9-23-00d1264/ broken-games-seattle-wa-9-23-00], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 24 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-broken-games-seattle-wa-9-23-00d1264/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Broken Games, Seattle, WA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 27
* '''Winner:''' [[Douglas Harvilla]]
